### <center> Why this modpack in particular? </center>

This modpack was created specifically for the **Time DoctoR’s — TDR** server (`IP: mc.timedoctorrb.ru`) and is fully adapted for maximum gaming comfort. Here you will find everything you need to enjoy every moment of the project!

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### <center> What you can expect in this modpack: </center>

- 🌅 **Shader support:** Fully compatible with popular shader packs to create the perfect atmosphere.
- ⚡ **Optimisation:** The build includes patches and improvements for stable and smooth gameplay, even during long sessions.
- 📢 **Voice chat:** The _Plasmo Voice_ mod for lively and direct communication with other players.
- 🎭 **Emotions and self-expression:** _Emotecraft_ will bring your character to life with a variety of animations and gestures.
- 🎥 **Recording adventures:** Save your most memorable moments with the _Flashback_ mod, and thanks to modifications for this mod, _Flashback_ can also record _Emotecraft_ and _Plasmo Voice_.
- 🚀 **Development:** Even more options, features, and mods to choose from are coming in the future!

### This modpack strikes the perfect balance between convenience, functionality, and the atmosphere of TDR IV.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)
